lines.name: SWRT total at Medium (Lite, irradiance field gather)
lines.reason: The GodotNext group is the NextGI frame block (nextgi_* without the closing marker's column and line 1b). The UE group takes every pass the captures show doing that work, by the lead's column rule (2026-11-16; plan §23.5 states it since v3.9.7, and the settings record now lists the observed columns): for line 1a's global SDF update, GPU/GlobalDistanceFieldUpdate, busy here and at 0 in the hardware-tier Lumen captures (it is also busy in the captures without Lumen, the PN and Upscaler Torture sets, so it may serve other UE features as well, which the lead weighs); the Lumen scene update, GPU/LumenSceneUpdate and GPU/UpdateLumenSceneBuffers; and Lumen Lite's passes (below). GPU/DistanceFields, busy in every capture on both tiers and in the sets without Lumen, stays out until the lead decides whether it does the work of line 1a's mesh SDF table upload. At Medium UE runs Lumen Lite: the game-mode captures on the RTX 4080 SUPER show GPU/LumenIrradianceFieldGather, while GPU/LumenScreenProbeGather and GPU/LumenReflections are absent or 0 (sg.ReflectionQuality 1 turns Lumen reflections off and GPU/ScreenSpaceReflections appears), so Lite's passes are the scene lighting and the irradiance field gather.
